From Wikidata on each thinker's own item: P1066 student of -> taught, P737 influenced by -> influenced, a shared P135 movement that is a school -> same school. 'Argued against' has no Wikidata property, so none are shown. Links where the influencer was born after the person influenced are dropped as data errors. Each link keeps its source.
